additional_requirements.title: Ensure changes in deployment configuration are audited
additional_requirements.text: For each deployment configuration, track and audit changes made to it.

additional_requirements.title: Ensure scanners are in place to identify and prevent sensitive data in deployment configuration
additional_requirements.text: For each deployment configuration file, set scanners to identify and prevent sensitive data within it.

additional_requirements.title: Limit access to deployment configurations
additional_requirements.text: Restrict access to the deployment configuration to trusted and qualified users.

additional_requirements.title: Ensure deployment configuration manifests are verified
additional_requirements.text: Verify each deployment configuration manifest in use.

additional_requirements.title: Ensure deployment configuration manifests are pinned to a specific, verified version
additional_requirements.text: For every deployment configuration manifest in use, pin to a specific version or commit Secure Hash Algorithm (SHA).

additional_requirements.title: Ensure deployment configuration files are separated from source code
additional_requirements.text: Store each deployment configuration file in a dedicated repository separately from source code.

additional_requirements.title: Scan Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
additional_requirements.text: For every Infrastructure as Code (IaC) instructions file, set scanners to identify and prevent misconfigurations and insecure instructions.
